title: biomes.brunt/1
description: data/biomes/brunt.json: what a launched body does to buildings (docs/world/destruction-hook.md, docs/design/buildings.md; WorldBrunt.cfg). The ladder by tier (tierFactor, towerPunches), the chain (chainMax, chainSpecial, houseLink), the energy a building takes (houseKeep, keepHi, keepK, keepRef, keepMin, keepFree, heavyKeep), the building that remembers its walls (giveWay, wallMemory, wallMin, heldDeathShare) and the lodge (lodgeSeconds, lodgeSpecialSeconds, lodgeDump). Every key has a default in the loader and the file carries them all, so every key is required here (a number cannot vanish unseen); the order rules are tools/lib/xref-brunt.js (brunt-order). Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

bruntMul.description: The damage scale of a brunt: speed x tierFactor x bruntMul.

tierFactor.description: By tier 1 to 4: the damage a body does a building per unit of normalised speed (before bruntMul). The ladder's slope: tier 1 a wall, tier 3 and 4 through.

specialTier.description: A finisher (a special launch) reads as at least this tier.

chainMax.description: Links a flight may use, by tier 1 to 4: a tower is one link, a house houseLink.

houseLink.description: What a house counts as of a link.

houseKeep.description: The share of speed kept through a house.

towerPunches.description: By tier 1 to 4: the towers a flight may go through. A tower beyond it holds the body (a wall), unless its covered floors have taken giveWay times their strength in damage. 0 at tier 1: a tier-1 hit never goes through an intact tower.

giveWay.description: A held tower gives way when the damage already taken on the floors a body covers is this many times their own strength (the remembered walls).

wallMemory.description: The share of the damage a floor has taken that is taken off its strength.

wallMin.description: A floor never weakens below this share of its own strength.

heldDeathShare.description: The most of the people on a held floor one hit kills.

lodgeSeconds.description: By tier: the seconds the last building of a chain holds the body (a hit-stop in the wall).

lodgeDump.description: The share of what is left of the launch taken as one more hit on the last building's core.

wallSlamMul.description: A body held at a wall takes this many times the building's hit (Game Design: twice).

wallStaggerTicks.description: The ticks a body held at a wall is staggered (input gated).

lodgeHold.description: Does a lodge or a wall hold the whole sim (world: a hit-stop) or only the body (body: he is stunned for the seconds and the fight goes on).

interiorChain.description: The chain inside a tower: 0 off (today's behaviour), 1 on.

interiorTanMin.description: The shallowest send that goes on inside: the tangent of 15 degrees.

interiorTanMax.description: The steepest send that goes on inside: the tangent of 60 degrees.

interiorCeilKeep.description: The speed kept off a ceiling (Game Design: 0.4).

interiorFloorKeep.description: The speed kept through a floor, or a face, that breaks (Game Design: 0.7).

interiorMaxContacts.description: The most slab and wall contacts of a chain (Game Design: 5).

interiorMaxBounces.description: The most bounces of a chain (Game Design: 3); no bounce is produced yet.

interiorFaceStop.description: The entry face's hit-stop in ticks (Game Design: 15).

interiorCapSeconds.description: The ragdolled time from the face to the end (Game Design: 2.5 s, inside the journey's 4 s).

interiorCeilTier.description: The effective tier from which a send reaches the ceiling (Game Design: 3).

interiorExitTier.description: The effective tier from which the far face breaks and he leaves; below it he lodges against it.

interiorHurt.description: The share of the face's per-speed damage a slab does him.
